origin.description: Estimates how far the correlation matrix should shrink toward the identity.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A data matrix, one observation per row.

arguments.name: w
arguments.text: One weight per row. Omitted means equal weights that sum to 1.

arguments.name: verbose
arguments.text: Print the intensity. The default is true.

origin.details: One column returns 1 immediately. Fewer than three rows raises an error. The off-diagonal sum follows Ahdesmäki's cumsum form.
